inclusion: Retain a classifier tag only if a separate model identifies an exact title or abstract span as supporting both the frozen facet definition and its status as a central contribution or evaluation target. Unsupported or uncertain tags remain in the private audit and are excluded from the navigation facets.
interpretation: A second model review is not a human ground truth. Retained tags remain unverified and the original classifier output is preserved.
name: strict-facet-full-validation-v1
request_start_policy: Three workers share one rate lock and the same minimum interval between request starts; parallelism overlaps model response latency.
